title: Member Services Training Bulletin: Open Case Limits and Withdrawal Terms in Appeals and Grievances
content:
**Appeals and Grievances** sets three terms per case type on how many open cases of one type may stand for the same related reference, whether a case may be withdrawn by phone, and whether a withdrawn case may be filed again while the original deadline still runs.

| Case type | Most open cases of this type for the same related reference | Withdrawal by phone accepted | Withdrawn case may be filed again while the original deadline still runs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Quality of Care Grievance | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Standard Appeal | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Expedited Appeal | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| State Fair Hearing | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| External Medical Review | 1 | Yes | Yes |

## Questions answered

**What is the most open cases of one case type the member may have for the same related reference?**
One, on every case type. The related reference is the decision or trip reference the case is about.

**May a member withdraw a case by phone?**
Yes, on every case type.

**May a withdrawn case be filed again?**
Yes, on every case type, while the original deadline still runs.

**Do these terms differ between grievances, plan appeals and the state or external reviews?**
No. The three terms are identical across all six case types.
